name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.genLevel
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀] [NumberField L₀], HasMuQ l L₀ →
∃ γ : G L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀), IsGen l ⊤ γ ∧ IsLevel l (cycZ L₀ _ l γ : ℤ_[l]) (cZero l L₀) ∧
∃ ζ : L₀, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ cZero l L₀) := by
have hM := muQ L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀) l
have hq : qExp l ≤ cZero l L₀ := hM.2.2.1.mp hmu
have hP := princGen l (cZero l L₀) hq
obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ : ∃ u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L₀), u ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L₀ + 1) := by
have hr := cycRange L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀) l hmu
obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : u ∈ (cycZ L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀) l).range := hr ▸ hu
show: For every prime ℓ and number field L₀ satisfying the roots-of-unity condition, there exists γ in its absolute Galois group that topologically generates the cyclotomic image. Its character has level c₀, the maximal ℓ-power root-of-unity depth in L₀, and L₀ contains a primitive ℓ^c₀th root.
strategy: Choose a unit of exact principal-unit depth c₀ and lift it through the cyclotomic character.

steps.claim: Let c₀ be the largest exponent a for which L₀ contains a primitive ℓ^a-th root of unity. For a number field the roots-of-unity criterion identifies the exponents with this property as exactly the natural a ≤ c₀.
steps.snippet:
∃ ζ : L₀, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ cZero l L₀) := by
  intro l _ L₀ _ _ hmu
  have hM := muQ L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀) l

steps.claim: The initial root of unity assumed in L₀ gives q ≤ c₀ by that criterion. Here q = 2 at ℓ = 2, from the primitive fourth root, and q = 1 at an odd prime, from the primitive ℓth root.
steps.snippet: have hq : qExp l ≤ cZero l L₀ := hM.2.2.1.mp hmu

steps.claim: Write P(a) for the units congruent to one modulo ℓ^a. Since c₀ ≥ q, the principal-unit theorem says that for u in P(c₀) outside P(c₀ + 1), the integer powers of u are dense in P(c₀) and vℓ(u − 1) = c₀. It also gives index ℓ for P(c₀ + 1) in P(c₀).
steps.snippet: have hP := princGen l (cZero l L₀) hq

steps.claim: There is a unit u in P(c₀) outside P(c₀ + 1). Otherwise the two nested groups would coincide, making their relative index one, whereas the principal-unit index formula gives ℓ > 1.
steps.snippet:
obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ : ∃ u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L₀), u ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L₀ + 1) := by
    by_contra hne
    push_neg at hne
    have h1 := hP.2.2 1
    rw [Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.mpr hne, pow_one] at h1
    exact (Fact.out : l.Prime).one_lt.ne h1
steps.typedFact: ∃ u ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L₀), u ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L₀ + 1)

steps.claim: For L₀ with the prescribed initial root of unity, the cyclotomic image of its full absolute Galois group is the principal-unit subgroup at depth c₀ by the cyclotomic range theorem.
steps.snippet: have hr := cycRange L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀) l hmu

steps.claim: The chosen u lies in that subgroup and hence in the image of the cyclotomic character. Choose γ in the absolute Galois group with κ(γ) = u.
steps.snippet: obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : u ∈ (cycZ L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀) l).range := hr ▸ hu

steps.claim: The element γ belongs to the full group by construction, and the root criterion at c₀ gives a primitive ℓ^c₀-th root in L₀. The exact depth of u gives the other two properties of γ, namely generation of the cyclotomic image and cyclotomic level c₀.

children.claim: Since u belongs to the depth-c₀ subgroup and lies outside the next subgroup, the closure of its integer powers is the entire depth-c₀ subgroup by the generator criterion. This subgroup is the cyclotomic image and u = κ(γ), so γ has the required generator property.
children.snippet:
· rw [← MonoidHom.range_eq_map, hr, hγ]
    exact (hP.1 u hu).mpr hu'

children.claim: Membership of u at depth c₀ and failure of membership at c₀ + 1 give vℓ(u − 1) = c₀ by the exact-level criterion. Together with c₀ ≥ q and κ(γ) = u, this gives cyclotomic level c₀ for γ.

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
